# 【IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT｜モココからのお知らせ】lots of love to the fuzz 🐾🩷【FUWAMOCO】

## ⚡ Quick Stream Highlights (TL;DR)
- Mococo has been diagnosed with an autoimmune disease and will be taking an indefinite hiatus from streaming for her recovery.
- During her hiatus, Mococo will continue working on her upcoming album, pouring her heart into the project.
- Fuwawa will continue streaming and pledges her full support to Mococo, requesting fans to respect Mococo's privacy.
- FUWAMOCO reflects on their three years since debut, expressing strong belief that they will overcome this challenge and return stronger.

## ⭐ Standout Stories & Timestamps
- **[⏱️ 00:01:06](#t=00:01:06) Mococo's Autoimmune Diagnosis Revealed**: Fuwawa tearfully announces that Mococo was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease earlier in the year, which has caused her recent struggles and necessitated this important announcement.
- **[⏱️ 00:02:26](#t=00:02:26) Mococo Announces Indefinite Hiatus**: Due to her worsening condition and the need to prioritize healing, Mococo will be taking an indefinite break from streaming to focus on her health, as any stress makes her recovery difficult.
- **[⏱️ 00:06:06](#t=00:06:06) Fuwawa Pledges Continued Streaming & Support**: Fuwawa vows to support Mococo in every way possible and continue streaming, asking fans to give her 'a thousand percent' of their support while Mococo is away and to avoid asking for health updates to ease her burden.
- **[⏱️ 00:08:18](#t=00:08:18) Mococo Continues Album Production**: Despite her temporary break from streaming, Mococo will continue working diligently on her upcoming album, pouring her heart into its production before taking a full rest.
- **[⏱️ 00:09:48](#t=00:09:48) FUWAMOCO's Three-Year Reflection & Hope**: Fuwawa reflects on their three years since debut, acknowledging the immense challenge ahead but expressing strong belief that FUWAMOCO will overcome Mococo's illness and return stronger to accomplish their dreams.

## ⏱️ Timeline Breakdown
- **[⏱️ 00:01:06](#t=00:01:06) Mococo's Indefinite Hiatus**: Fuwawa delivers a somber but important announcement regarding Mococo's health, revealing that Mococo was diagnosed with an autoimmune disease earlier in the year. Due to her condition, Mococo will be taking an indefinite hiatus from streaming to focus on her recovery, as stress exacerbates her illness. Fuwawa explains that Mococo wanted to be present but is currently resting, and requests fans to respect Mococo's privacy by refraining from asking Fuwawa for updates. Despite the break, Mococo will continue working on her upcoming album. Fuwawa pledges to do her best to support Mococo and continue streaming, asking fans for their unwavering support. She reflects on their three years since debut, acknowledging the immense challenge ahead but expresses strong belief that they will overcome this adversity together and return stronger to accomplish their shared dreams.
